2026-11-18.homeNewsDetails: Hellebucyk will start vs. Montreal on Wednesday.
2026-11-18.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hellebuyck has been excellent since joining the Devils, yet to lose a game (7-0-0), and will return to the crease on Wednesday. The 33-year-old American goalie is coming off his busiest outing of the season, saving 42 of 46 shots (.913 SV%) in a 7-4 win over the Washington Capitals. In his last three games (3-0-0), Hellebuyck has a 2.01 GAA and .938 SV%. The Devils enter Wednesday's game as -162 home favourites against a Montreal Canadiens team that has been outscored 7-2 in their past two games (0-2-0).
2026-11-18.awayNewsDetails: Fowler will start in New Jersey on Wednesday.
2026-11-18.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Jakub Dobes had a breakout 2025-26 season, leading the Canadiens to an impressive playoff run, but his sluggish start to 2026-27 opened the door for Jacob Fowler, who hasn't backed down from the challenge. That said, the 21-year-old Fowler is coming off a rare regulation loss, just his second of the season (9-2-2), allowing three goals on 26 shots (.885 SV%) in a 3-1 loss to the New York Rangers. The Canadiens enter Wednesday's game as +149 road underdogs against a red-hot New Jersey Devils team that has scored four or more goals in seven of their last eight games (7-1-0).

2026-11-18.homeNewsDetails: Tarasov will start vs. Boston on Wednesday.
2026-11-18.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Tarasov has unexpectedly been getting more playing time in recent weeks, emerging as one of the NHL's most consistent goalies this season. The 27-year-old is coming off a 31-save performance for his second shutout of the season in a 2-0 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning. In nine games (3-3-2), Tarasov has a stellar 1.84 GAA and a .931 SV%.
2026-11-18.awayNewsDetails: Swayman will start Wednesday in Detroit.

2026-11-18.homeNewsDetails: Cossa will start Wednesday vs. the Avalanche.
2026-11-18.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Utah has struggled lately regardless of who is between the pipes, as Cossa has squandered an opportunity to steal starts from Karel Vejmelka. Cossa, a 23-year-old rookie, has had some encouraging performances but has been inconsistent. In his last two games (0-1-1), Cossa has allowed 10 goals on 63 combined shots (.841 SV%). He has allowed three or more goals in four of his last six games (3-2-1). The Mammoth enter Wednesday's game as slight -109 home favourites against an injury-depleted Colorado Avalanche team that is coming off an impressive 4-1 win over the Montreal Canadiens.
2026-11-18.awayNewsDetails: Blackwood will start in Utah on Wednesday.
2026-11-18.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Blackwood has had some ups and downs early in the 2026-27 season, but remains Colorado's go-to option, as Scott Wedgewood has been unable to find his footing. Inconsistencies aside, Blackwood has won 11 of 15 starts (3-1-1) and is coming off a solid 25-save performance (.962 SV%), defeating the Montreal Canadiens 4-1. In his last three games (3-0-0), Blackwood has a 1.34 GAA and a .952 SV%. The Avalanche enter Wednesday's game as -101 road underdogs against a struggling Utah Mammoth team that has lost six straight games (0-3-3).

2026-11-19.awayNewsDetails: Dobes will start in Carolina on Thursday.
2026-11-19.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After a breakout 2025-26 season that continued with an impressive postseason run, Dobes has struggled early in 2026-27. As a result, the Canadiens have often turned to Jacob Fowler, but they will turn to Dobes in the tail end of a back-to-back on Thursday against the Carolina Hurricanes. Despite his early season struggles, the 25-year-old Dobes has played marginally better lately, posting a 3.04 GAA and .862 SV% in his last three games (2-1-0).
